## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

HyroxTypeConverters — core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/db/HyroxTypeConverters.kt

## Trigger

Any Room read that decodes a `RaceEntity.origin`, `RaceEntity.completion`
or `ProfileEntity.zoneThresholds` column — `RaceDao.observeAll`,
`RaceDao.findById`, `RaceDao.observeReference`, `ProfileDao.observe`, and
every other query Room maps through `HyroxTypeConverters` — observed.

## Today

`HyroxTypeConverters.toRaceOrigin` and `toRaceCompletion` call
`RaceOrigin.valueOf(value)` / `RaceCompletion.valueOf(value)` on the
stored column, and `toZoneThresholds` calls `it.toInt()` on each
comma-separated part of the stored string. None of the three guards its
input: a stored name that no longer matches an enum constant, or a
stored threshold that is not a parseable integer, raises inside Room's
own cursor mapping, on every read of the row that carries it — through
`RaceRepositoryImpl` (`observeAll`, `findById`, `observeReference`) and
`ProfileRepositoryImpl.observe`, with no way for the caller to recover
since the throw happens before repository code runs.

Separately, `HyroxDatabase` (version 2, `RaceEntity`, `SegmentEntity`,
`RetainedFactorEntity`, `RejectedCalibrationEntity`, `ProfileEntity`) is
opened in both `app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/di/RepositoryModule.kt`
and `app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/di/RepositoryModule.kt`
via `Room.databaseBuilder(context, HyroxDatabase::class.java,
HYROX_DATABASE_NAME).addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2).build()`. Neither
builder calls `fallbackToDestructiveMigration()`, and neither wraps the
`.build()` / first query in anything that catches a migration failure:
a schema found off the path `MIGRATION_1_2` covers (a version other than
1 or 2, or a version-2 database that does not match the exported
schema) raises `IllegalStateException` at the first query, on both
apps.

## Expected

`HyroxTypeConverters.toRaceOrigin`, `toRaceCompletion` and
`toZoneThresholds` recognise a stored value that does not decode and
return a well-defined fallback instead of raising, so a row a caller
cannot read no longer crashes every read of the table that holds it.

`app-phone/.../di/RepositoryModule.kt` and
`app-wear/.../di/RepositoryModule.kt` — both `provideHyroxDatabase` —
guard the migration: either the database builder declares a destructive
fallback for the versions `MIGRATION_1_2` cannot bridge, or the build is
wrapped so a migration failure does not raise unrecovered at the first
query. This is a second location the fix must touch, distinct from the
converters: the two apps' `RepositoryModule.kt` objects are the callers
that configure the same `HyroxDatabase` bearer, and both need the same
guard.
